Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

3. Designation — A socket reamer Type A having designating size Morse 4 and made from high speed 
steel ( HS) shall be designated as: 

Reamer A Morse 4 IS : 5882-HS 

3.1 When required in a set of three reamers comprising one each of Types A. B and C, the letter * A * 
shall be omitted in the designation above.

5. Ganaral Raquiramants 

5.1 Flutes, unless specified otherwise shall be as follows: 

a) Type A — Right hand helical flutes for right-hand cutting. 

b) Type B— Parallel flutes for right-hand cutting. 

c) Type C — Left hand helical flutes for right-hand cutting. 

5.2 Other requirements according to IS ; 5443-1969 ' Technical supply conditions for reamers 



Explanatory Note 

In order to bring in line with the work done at ISO level, the Small Tools Sectional Committee 
decided to revise IS : 1836-1961 and to split it up Into a series of standards. This standard covers 
the dimensional requirements for socket reamers with parallel shanks. The technical supply conditions 
for reamers and the dimensional requirements of various other reamers are covered in separate 
standards. 



Printed at New India Printing Press. Khurja, India
